text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes.
In
response to the videos she filmed
during
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян is receiving support from an
entirely
different fan base from before!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Каррен Тян is racing against a
formidable
opponent today... one who is
also gaining
popularity on
Umatter—Нишино Флауэр.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян is determined to beat her
and prove
that she is the cutest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
